grounding.from: Notes are for Denver, Colorado. "Tomorrow" is Tuesday, October 13, 2026.
The National Weather Service in Boulder said to expect partly sunny skies Tuesday
The high is expected to reach 65 degrees
Weather Underground has a high of 64°F, partly cloudy. AccuWeather has a high of 67°. 9NEWS has a high of 64.
North-northeast winds of 6 to 10 mph are expected
The weather service gives a 30% chance of rain after 3 p.m.

value.answer: Tuesday in Denver looks partly sunny with a high around 65°. Winds are light, north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph. Rain has about a 30% chance after 3 p.m. and gets more likely through the evening, with lows in the 30s and low 40s overnight.
